title: ClaimEvent
description: Claim lifecycle event (synthetic). Contract v1; subject claims.events.v1-value; compatibility BACKWARD. Open content model: producers may add optional properties in a compatible revision.

event_id.description: Unique event id; the dedupe key (duplicates are re-sent verbatim).

event_ts.description: Event time, UTC, second precision. May arrive out of order.

amount.description: Event amount. Negatives exist upstream (injected defect) and are a silver-layer rule, not a contract rule.
